Gamer.description: A player or staff member on the esports roster, known by their handle. A first name alone is not an identity.

Sponsor.description: A company that backs the team or its players.

Roster.description: Who leads or reviews whom inside the team: a shotcaller makes the in-game calls for a player, an analyst reviews their play.

Deal.description: A gamer's tie to a sponsor: endorsing the brand as an ambassador, or streaming on its behalf.

Match.description: One scrim or official match against another team. arranged_by set it up, mvp was the best player, benched sat it out; result is upcoming, won, lost or forfeited.

Payout.description: A gamer's share of a tournament prize. paid_out stays empty until a payment is recorded.

messages.text: Takumi Hasegawa: Luana Kealoha is my shotcaller now, so I follow her calls every round.

facts.in: Luana Kealoha is my shotcaller now
facts.label: shotcaller

messages.text: Scrim log: our scrim against Ironclad Seven was won over 3 maps, arranged by Zainab Oyelaran, with Oskar Brandvold as MVP.

facts.in: our scrim against Ironclad Seven was won over 3 maps

messages.text: Zainab Oyelaran: Amaru Quispe and Amaru Condori both asked for the Sunday slot. Amaru said he wants a new headset too.
Mateus Barbosa says Kestrel Energy signed him as an ambassador last month. He will also stream for Northwind Peripherals from April.

facts.in: Mateus Barbosa says Kestrel Energy signed him as an ambassador last month.
facts.label: endorses

facts.in: He will also stream for Northwind Peripherals from April.
facts.label: streams_for

messages.text: Oskar Brandvold: My share of the Frostline Open prize is 900 dollars, and I still have not been paid.

facts.in: My share of the Frostline Open prize is 900 dollars

messages.text: Finance: the 450 dollars owed to Luana Kealoha from the Frostline Open was paid out on Monday.

facts.in: the 450 dollars owed to Luana Kealoha from the Frostline Open was paid out on Monday.

messages.text: Luana Kealoha: I'm not Amaru Quispe's analyst any more. Zainab reviews his matches now.

facts.in: I'm not Amaru Quispe's analyst any more.
facts.label: analyst

facts.in: Zainab reviews his matches now.
facts.label: analyst

messages.text: Zainab Oyelaran: I think the qualifier against Redline Academy is upcoming on Saturday, maybe with Mateus benched.

facts.in: I think the qualifier against Redline Academy is upcoming on Saturday

messages.text: Clip caption from Takumi Hasegawa: "Oskar Brandvold carried that final map, I owe him one." He posted it after the scrim.
quotes: Oskar Brandvold carried that final map, I owe him one.

messages.text: I pinned "warm-up starts at seven sharp" in the team channel, and Luana Kealoha reacted with a thumbs up.
Amaru Condori: If we qualify, Takumi Hasegawa will be my shotcaller for the main event.

facts.in: Takumi Hasegawa will be my shotcaller
facts.label: shotcaller

messages.text: The grand final against Polar Tide was won over 5 maps at the Kessel Arena, streamed live, with Luana Kealoha as MVP and Amaru Condori benched.

facts.in: The grand final against Polar Tide was won over 5 maps

messages.text: Mateus Barbosa: Zainab, could you arrange a scrim against Lantern Ghosts for Thursday and bench me for it?

facts.in: Zainab, could you arrange a scrim against Lantern Ghosts

messages.text: Amaru Condori: People keep confusing me with the other Amaru. Oskar is Amaru Quispe's captain, not mine.

facts.in: Oskar is Amaru Quispe's captain
facts.label: shotcaller

facts.in: not mine
facts.label: shotcaller

messages.text: Hi all, the match against Polar Tide on the 14th is upcoming: not streamed, venue the Kessel Arena basement. I booked the room myself. Cheers, Zainab

facts.in: the match against Polar Tide on the 14th is upcoming

messages.text: Takumi Hasegawa said that Luana Kealoha streams for Northwind Peripherals, not for Kestrel Energy.

facts.in: Luana Kealoha streams for Northwind Peripherals
facts.label: streams_for

facts.in: not for Kestrel Energy
facts.label: streams_for

messages.text: Amaru Quispe's payout from the Ember Cup came to 300 dollars and has been paid. Amaru thanked Zainab for chasing it.

facts.in: Amaru Quispe's payout from the Ember Cup came to 300 dollars and has been paid.

messages.text: Luana Kealoha streamed until midnight. A different Luana, a trialist from the academy, messaged her afterwards.
Minutes, Tuesday review: Zainab Oyelaran will be the analyst for Takumi Hasegawa next split. Mateus Barbosa becomes Oskar Brandvold's shotcaller from Friday.

facts.in: Zainab Oyelaran will be the analyst for Takumi Hasegawa next split.
facts.label: analyst

facts.in: Mateus Barbosa becomes Oskar Brandvold's shotcaller from Friday.
facts.label: shotcaller

messages.text: Luana Kealoha: Mateus Barbosa was ill, so the match against Redline Academy was forfeited; Mateus says he is sorry.

facts.in: so the match against Redline Academy was forfeited

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)-[:shotcaller]->(n1:Gamer) WHERE n0.handle = 'Takumi Hasegawa' RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.speaker: amaru
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)-[:analyst]->(n1:Gamer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.speaker: luana
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)-[:squad]->(n1:Gamer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.q: Which sponsors am I an ambassador for?
questions.speaker: mateus
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)-[:endorses]->(n1:Sponsor) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.brand AS brand

questions.q: Who are the streamers of Northwind Peripherals?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sponsor)-[:streamers]->(n1:Gamer) WHERE n0.brand = 'Northwind Peripherals' RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.q: How many maps were played against Polar Tide?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Match) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Polar Tide' RETURN n0.maps_played AS maps_played

questions.q: Which matches did Zainab Oyelaran arrange?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)<-[:arranged_by]-(n1:Match) WHERE n0.handle = 'Zainab Oyelaran' RETURN n1.opponent AS opponent

questions.q: Which matches am I benched for?
questions.speaker: mateus
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)<-[:benched]-(n1:Match) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.opponent AS opponent

questions.q: Is there a record of the Polar Tide match being streamed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Match) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Polar Tide' RETURN coalesce(n0.streamed, false) AS streamed

questions.q: Was the match against Ironclad Seven streamed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Match) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Ironclad Seven' RETURN n0.streamed AS streamed

questions.q: Has Oskar Brandvold's prize been paid out?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)<-[:payee]-(n1:Payout) WHERE n0.handle = 'Oskar Brandvold' RETURN n1.paid_out AS paid_out

questions.q: What tournament and amount is each payout for?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Payout) RETURN n0.tournament AS tournament, n0.amount_dollars AS amount_dollars

questions.q: What timezone is Takumi Hasegawa in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer) WHERE n0.handle = 'Takumi Hasegawa' RETURN n0.timezone AS timezone

questions.q: Who was MVP of the match against Ironclad Seven?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Match)-[:mvp]->(n1:Gamer) WHERE n0.opponent = 'Ironclad Seven' RETURN n1.handle AS handle

questions.q: How much did Luana Kealoha get from the Frostline Open?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Gamer)<-[:payee]-(n1:Payout) WHERE n0.handle = 'Luana Kealoha' AND n1.tournament CONTAINS 'frostline' RETURN n1.amount_dollars AS amount_dollars
